_about: Labelled merchant descriptions for the category step. gold = status the taxonomy row carries; ids = acceptable sub-category ids (any one counts); kind = en | hi | te | ambiguous | adversarial. 'ask' = true when a careful reviewer would need one more fact before deciding.
